name: Chondrosarcoma
definition: Malignant cartilage-producing bone tumor, more common in adults and frequently involving pelvis, proximal femur, shoulder girdle or ribs.

investigations.principle: Radiographs/CT assess mineralized matrix; MRI defines local extent; biopsy requires sarcoma planning.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Treatment is subtype-specific and surgery is central for many conventional lesions.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vikara phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Malignant cartilage-producing bone tumor, more common in adults and frequently involving pelvis, proximal femur, shoulder girdle or ribs.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
